title: ONLINE TEST MANTRA — SHIV OMKARA
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Traditional morning shloka; attribution varies.
sanskrit: कराग्रे वसते लक्ष्मीः करमध्ये सरस्वती । करमूले तु गोविन्दः प्रभाते करदर्शनम् ॥
transliteration: Karāgre vasate Lakṣmīḥ karamadhye Sarasvatī | Karamūle tu Govindaḥ prabhāte karadarśanam ||
meaning: At the fingertips dwells Lakshmi, in the middle Saraswati, and at the base Govinda; therefore look at the palms in the morning.

title: Samudravasane Devi
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Traditional morning Earth-prayer; attribution varies.
sanskrit: समुद्रवसने देवि पर्वतस्तनमण्डले । विष्णुपत्नि नमस्तुभ्यं पादस्पर्शं क्षमस्व मे ॥
transliteration: Samudra-vasane devi parvata-stana-maṇḍale | Viṣṇu-patni namastubhyaṃ pāda-sparśaṃ kṣamasva me ||
meaning: O Goddess Earth, clothed by the oceans and with mountains as your breasts, consort of Vishnu, forgive my touching you with my feet.

title: Brahma Murari Tripurantakari
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Traditional suprabhātam verse; attribution varies.
sanskrit: ब्रह्मा मुरारिस्त्रिपुरान्तकारी भानुः शशी भूमिसुतो बुधश्च । गुरुश्च शुक्रः शनिराहुकेतवः कुर्वन्तु सर्वे मम सुप्रभातम् ॥
transliteration: Brahmā Murāris Tripurāntakārī Bhānuḥ Śaśī Bhūmisuto Budhaśca | Guruśca Śukraḥ Śanirāhu-Ketavaḥ Kurvantu Sarve Mama Suprabhātam ||
meaning: May Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu make my morning auspicious.

title: Gurur Brahma Gurur Vishnu
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Guru Stotra; commonly associated with Guru Gita / Skanda Purana tradition.
sanskrit: गुरुर्ब्रह्मा गुरुर्विष्णुः गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः । गुरुः साक्षात् परं ब्रह्म तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः ॥
transliteration: Gurur Brahmā Gurur Viṣṇuḥ Gurur Devo Maheśvaraḥ | Guruḥ Sākṣāt Paraṃ Brahma Tasmai Śrī-Gurave Namaḥ ||
meaning: The Guru is Brahma, Vishnu and Maheshvara; the Guru is directly the Supreme Brahman. Salutations to the revered Guru.

title: Karacharana Kritam Vaa
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Śiva Mānasapūjā, traditionally attributed to Ādi Śaṅkarācārya.
sanskrit: करचरणकृतं वाक्कायजं कर्मजं वा । श्रवणनयनजं वा मानसं वापराधम् । विहितमविहितं वा सर्वमेतत्क्षमस्व । जय जय करुणाब्धे श्रीप्रभो मन्मथारे ॥
transliteration: Kara-caraṇa-kṛtaṃ vāk-kāya-jaṃ karma-jaṃ vā | Śravaṇa-nayana-jaṃ vā mānasaṃ vāparādham | Vihitam-avihitaṃ vā sarvam etat kṣamasva | Jaya jaya karuṇābdhe śrī-prabho manmathāre ||
meaning: Forgive all offenses committed through hands, feet, speech, body, actions, hearing, sight or mind, whether intentional or unintentional.

title: Vakratunda Mahakaya
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Traditional Ganesha prayer; attribution varies.
sanskrit: वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटि समप्रभ । निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव शुभकार्येषु सर्वदा ॥
transliteration: Vakratunda mahākāya sūryakoṭi samaprabha | Nirvighnaṃ kuru me deva śubhakāryeṣu sarvadā ||
meaning: O curved-trunk, mighty-bodied Lord, radiant like millions of suns, make my auspicious undertakings free of obstacles.

title: Ganapati Mula Mantra
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Gaṇapatyatharvaśīrṣa; the text gives the Ganapati mantra.
sanskrit: ॐ गं गणपतये नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to Lord Ganesha.

title: Gayatri Mantra
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Ṛgveda 3.62.10; transmitted in other Vedic recensions too.
sanskrit: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः । तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
transliteration: Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ | Tat savitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | Dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
meaning: We meditate on the divine radiance of Savitr; may that light inspire and guide our intellect.

title: Asato Ma Sadgamaya
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 1.3.28.
sanskrit: ॐ असतो मा सद्गमय । तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय । मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय ॥
transliteration: Oṃ asato mā sadgamaya | Tamaso mā jyotirgamaya | Mṛtyor mā amṛtaṃ gamaya ||
meaning: Lead me from the unreal to the real, from darkness to light, and from death to immortality.

title: Mahamrityunjaya Mantra
purpose: Morning gratitude, auspicious beginning, remembrance, humility
source: Ṛgveda 7.59.12; widely used in Śaiva practice.
sanskrit: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ॥
transliteration: Oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam | Urvārukam iva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya mā'mṛtāt ||
meaning: We worship the three-eyed Lord who nourishes all; may we be freed from the bondage of death, like a ripe fruit from its stem, but not from immortality.

title: Om Suryaya Namah
purpose: Sunrise worship, vitality, discipline, illumination, gratitude
source: Traditional Surya nama mantra.
sanskrit: ॐ सूर्याय नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ Sūryāya Namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to Surya, the Sun.

title: Om Adityaya Namah
purpose: Sunrise worship, vitality, discipline, illumination, gratitude
source: Traditional Surya nama mantra.
sanskrit: ॐ आदित्याय नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ Ādityāya Namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to Aditya.

title: Om Bhaskaraya Namah
purpose: Sunrise worship, vitality, discipline, illumination, gratitude
source: Traditional Surya nama mantra.
sanskrit: ॐ भास्कराय नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ Bhāskarāya Namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to the radiant Sun.

title: Surya Gayatri
purpose: Sunrise worship, vitality, discipline, illumination, gratitude
source: Traditional Surya Gayatri; wording varies by tradition.
sanskrit: ॐ आदित्याय विद्महे दिवाकराय धीमहि । तन्नः सूर्यः प्रचोदयात् ॥
transliteration: Oṃ Ādityāya vidmahe Divākarāya dhīmahi | Tanno Sūryaḥ pracodayāt ||
meaning: We contemplate Aditya, the maker of the day; may Surya inspire and illumine us.

title: Aditya Hridayam
purpose: Sunrise worship, vitality, discipline, illumination, gratitude
source: Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa; chapter/sarga numbering varies by edition.
sanskrit: आदित्यहृदयम् स्तोत्रम्
transliteration: Āditya Hṛdayam Stotram
meaning:
A hymn of praise to Aditya (the Sun), taught to Rama by Agastya before battle.

title: Jabakusuma Sankasham
purpose: Sunrise worship, vitality, discipline, illumination, gratitude
source: Traditional Surya stuti.
sanskrit: जपाकुसुमसङ्काशं काश्यपेयṁ महद्युतिम् । तमोऽरिं सर्वपापघ्नं प्रणतोऽस्मि दिवाकरम् ॥
transliteration: Japākusuma-saṅkāśaṃ Kāśyapeyaṃ mahādyutim | Tamo'riṃ sarva-pāpaghnaṃ praṇato'smi Divākaram ||
meaning: I bow to the Sun, radiant like a hibiscus, son of Kashyapa, destroyer of darkness and remover of sin.

title: Namah Savitre Jagadeka Chakshushe
purpose: Sunrise worship, vitality, discipline, illumination, gratitude
source: Traditional Surya prayer; textual attribution varies.
sanskrit: नमः सवित्रे जगदेकचक्षुषे जगत्प्रसूति-स्थितिनाशहेतवे । त्रयीमयाय त्रिगुणात्मधारिणे विरिञ्चिनारायणशङ्करात्मने ॥
transliteration: Namaḥ Savitre jagad-eka-cakṣuṣe jagat-prasūti-sthiti-nāśa-hetave | Trayīmayāya triguṇātma-dhāriṇe Viriñci-Nārāyaṇa-Śaṅkarātmane ||
meaning: Salutations to Savitr, the one eye of the world, source of creation, preservation and dissolution, embodying the Vedas and divine forms.

title: Mitra Ravi Surya Bhanu Khaga Pushan Hiranyagarbha
purpose: Sunrise worship, vitality, discipline, illumination, gratitude
source: Traditional Surya-namaskara name-mantra sequence; wording varies.
sanskrit: ॐ मित्राय नमः । ॐ रवये नमः । ॐ सूर्याय नमः । ॐ भानवे नमः । ॐ खगाय नमः । ॐ पूष्णे नमः । ॐ हिरण्यगर्भाय नमः ।
transliteration: Oṃ Mitrāya Namaḥ | Oṃ Ravaye Namaḥ | Oṃ Sūryāya Namaḥ | Oṃ Bhānave Namaḥ | Oṃ Khagāya Namaḥ | Oṃ Pūṣṇe Namaḥ | Oṃ Hiraṇyagarbhāya Namaḥ |
meaning: Salutations to the Sun through traditional names such as Mitra, Ravi, Surya, Bhanu, Khaga, Pushan and Hiranyagarbha.

title: Saraswati Namastubhyam
purpose: Learning, memory, speech, concentration, wisdom
source: Traditional Saraswati prayer.
sanskrit: सरस्वति नमस्तुभ्यं वरदे कामरूपिणि । विद्यारम्भं करिष्यामि सिद्धिर्भवतु मे सदा ॥
transliteration: Sarasvati namastubhyaṃ varade kāmarūpiṇi | Vidyārambhaṃ kariṣyāmi siddhir bhavatu me sadā ||
meaning: O Saraswati, giver of boons, I bow to you; as I begin study, may I always attain success.

title: Ya Kundendu Tusharahara
purpose: Learning, memory, speech, concentration, wisdom
source: Traditional Saraswati stuti; attribution varies.
sanskrit: या कुन्देन्दुतुषारहारधवला या शुभ्रवस्त्रावृता । या वीणावरदण्डमण्डितकरा या श्वेतपद्मासना । या ब्रह्माच्युतशङ्करप्रभृतिभिर्देवैः सदा वन्दिता । सा मां पातु सरस्वती भगवती निःशेषजाड्यापहा ॥
transliteration: Yā kundendu-tuṣārahāra-dhavalā yā śubhra-vastrāvṛtā | Yā vīṇā-vara-daṇḍa-maṇḍita-karā yā śveta-padmāsanā | Yā brahmācyuta-śaṅkara-prabhṛtibhir devaiḥ sadā vanditā | Sā māṃ pātu Sarasvatī Bhagavatī niḥśeṣa-jāḍyāpahā ||
meaning: May Goddess Saraswati, radiant like jasmine, moon and snow, holding the veena and seated on a white lotus, remove dullness and protect me.

title: Saraswati Gayatri
purpose: Learning, memory, speech, concentration, wisdom
source: Traditional Saraswati Gayatri; variants exist.
sanskrit: ॐ वाग्देव्यै च विद्महे कामराजाय धीमहि । तन्नो देवी प्रचोदयात् ॥
transliteration: Oṃ Vāgdevyai ca vidmahe Kāmarājāya dhīmahi | Tanno Devī pracodayāt ||
meaning: We contemplate the Goddess of speech; may the Divine Mother inspire us.

title: Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah
purpose: Learning, memory, speech, concentration, wisdom
source: Traditional Saraswati japa mantra; beej form.
sanskrit: ॐ ऐं सरस्वत्यै नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ aiṃ Sarasvatyai namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to Goddess Saraswati, associated with knowledge, learning and speech.

title: Medha Suktam
purpose: Learning, memory, speech, concentration, wisdom
source: Vedic Medha Sūkta tradition; recensional variants exist.
sanskrit: मेधासूक्तम्
transliteration: Medhā Sūktam
meaning:
A Vedic prayer for medha—understanding, retention and intellectual clarity.

title: Medham Me Varuna
purpose: Learning, memory, speech, concentration, wisdom
source: Medha-related Vedic prayer; recensional variants exist.
sanskrit: ॐ मेधां मे वरुणो ददातु । मेधामग्निः प्रजापतिः । मेधामिन्द्रश्च वायुश्च मेधां धाता ददातु मे ॥
transliteration: Oṃ medhāṃ me Varuṇo dadātu | Medhām Agniḥ Prajāpatiḥ | Medhām Indraśca Vāyuśca medhāṃ Dhātā dadātu me ||
meaning: May Varuna, Agni, Prajapati, Indra, Vayu and Dhata grant me intelligence and understanding.

title: Om Aing Hring Shring
purpose: Learning, memory, speech, concentration, wisdom
source: Tantric/Devi practice; use according to one's tradition.
sanskrit: ॐ ऐं ह्रीं श्रीं ॥
transliteration: Oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ
meaning: A traditional combination of seed syllables associated with knowledge, divine power and auspiciousness.

title: Hayagriva Mantra
purpose: Learning, memory, speech, concentration, wisdom
source: Traditional Vaishnava mantra; variants exist.
sanskrit: ॐ श्रीं हयग्रीवाय नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ śrīṃ Hayagrīvāya namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to Hayagriva, a form of Vishnu associated with knowledge.

title: Brahmarpanam Brahma Havir
purpose: Gratitude for food, mindful eating, offering food to the Divine
source: Bhagavad Gītā 4.24.
sanskrit: ॐ ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम् । ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना ॥
transliteration: Oṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ brahma havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam | Brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahma-karma-samādhinā ||
meaning: The offering is Brahman, the oblation is Brahman, offered into the fire of Brahman; one who sees Brahman in action reaches Brahman.

title: Annam Brahma Raso Vishnuh
purpose: Gratitude for food, mindful eating, offering food to the Divine
source: Traditional bhojana shloka; attribution varies.
sanskrit: अन्नं ब्रह्म रसो विष्णुः भोक्ता देवो महेश्वरः । एवं ज्ञात्वा तु यो भुङ्क्ते अन्नदोषो न विद्यते ॥
transliteration: Annaṃ brahma raso Viṣṇuḥ bhoktā devo Maheśvaraḥ | Evaṃ jñātvā tu yo bhuṅkte annadoṣo na vidyate ||
meaning: Food is reverently contemplated as Brahman, its sustaining essence as Vishnu, and the eater as Maheshvara.

title: Bhojana Mantra Om Sah Navavatu
purpose: Gratitude for food, mindful eating, offering food to the Divine
source: Taittirīya Upaniṣad tradition; used as an Upanishadic Shanti mantra.
sanskrit: ॐ सह नाववतु । सह नौ भुनक्तु । सह वीर्यं करवावहै । तेजस्विनावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै ॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ saha nāvavatu | Saha nau bhunaktu | Saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai | Tejasvināv adhītam astu mā vidviṣāvahai | Oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
meaning: May we both be protected and nourished; may we work with vigor; may our study be radiant; may we not hate one another.

title: Govinda Bhojan Mantra
purpose: Gratitude for food, mindful eating, offering food to the Divine
source: Traditional devotional food practice; wording varies.
sanskrit: गोविन्दं स्मरन् भुञ्जीत ।
transliteration: Govindaṃ smaran bhuñjīta
meaning: Remember Govinda while eating.

title: Prana Ahuti
purpose: Gratitude for food, mindful eating, offering food to the Divine
source: Traditional bhojana/āhuti practice; wording varies.
sanskrit: ॐ प्राणाय स्वाहा । ॐ अपानाय स्वाहा । ॐ व्यानाय स्वाहा । ॐ उदानाय स्वाहा । ॐ समानाय स्वाहा ॥
transliteration: Oṃ prāṇāya svāhā | Oṃ apānāya svāhā | Oṃ vyānāya svāhā | Oṃ udānāya svāhā | Oṃ samānāya svāhā ||
meaning: Traditional food-offering practice that mentally offers to the five vital airs: prana, apana, vyana, udana and samana.

title: Om Gam Ganapataye Namah
purpose: Beginnings, removal of obstacles, focus, auspicious action
source: Gaṇapatyatharvaśīrṣa.
sanskrit: ॐ गं गणपतये नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to Ganesha.

title: Ekadantaya Vidmahe
purpose: Beginnings, removal of obstacles, focus, auspicious action
source: Gaṇapatyatharvaśīrṣa, Ganesha Gayatri.
sanskrit: ॐ एकदन्ताय विद्महे वक्रतुण्डाय धीमहि । तन्नो दन्तिः प्रचोदयात् ॥
transliteration: Oṃ ekadantāya vidmahe vakratuṇḍāya dhīmahi | Tanno dantiḥ pracodayāt ||
meaning: We contemplate the one-tusked, curved-trunk Lord; may Ganesha inspire us.

title: Gajananam Bhutaganadi Sevitam
purpose: Beginnings, removal of obstacles, focus, auspicious action
source: Traditional Ganesha prayer.
sanskrit: गजाननं भूतगणादि सेवितं कपित्थजम्बूफलचारुभक्षणम् । उमासुतं शोकविनाशकारणं नमामि विघ्नेश्वरपादपङ्कजम् ॥
transliteration: Gajānanaṃ bhūta-gaṇādi-sevitaṃ kapittha-jambū-phala-cāru-bhakṣaṇam | Umā-sutaṃ śoka-vināśa-kāraṇaṃ namāmi Vighneśvara-pāda-paṅkajam ||
meaning: I bow to Vighneshvara, elephant-faced son of Uma, traditionally invoked for auspicious beginnings and removal of sorrow and obstacles.

title: Shuklambaradharam Vishnum
purpose: Beginnings, removal of obstacles, focus, auspicious action
source: Traditional opening prayer; recited before many puja/ritual contexts.
sanskrit: शुक्लाम्बरधरं विष्णुं शशिवर्णं चतुर्भुजम् । प्रसन्नवदनं ध्यायेत् सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये ॥
transliteration: Śuklāmbaradharaṃ Viṣṇuṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujam | Prasanna-vadanaṃ dhyāyet sarva-vighnopaśāntaye ||
meaning: Meditate on the four-armed, white-robed, moon-hued Lord with a serene face for the pacification of obstacles.

title: Siddhi Vinayak Mantra
purpose: Beginnings, removal of obstacles, focus, auspicious action
source: Traditional Ganesha nama mantra.
sanskrit: ॐ श्री सिद्धिविनायकाय नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ śrī siddhivināyakāya namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to Siddhivinayaka, Ganesha associated with accomplishment.

title: Riddhi Siddhi Mantra
purpose: Beginnings, removal of obstacles, focus, auspicious action
source: Traditional devotional mantra.
sanskrit: ॐ रिद्धिसिद्धिभ्यां नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ riddhi-siddhibhyāṃ namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to Riddhi and Siddhi, traditionally associated with Ganesha.

title: Om Shreem Mahalakshmyai Namah
purpose: Beginnings, removal of obstacles, focus, auspicious action
source: Traditional Lakshmi japa mantra; beej form.
category: Work / Success / New Beginnings, Devi / Lakshmi / Saraswati / Durga
sanskrit: ॐ श्रीं महालक्ष्म्यै नमः ॥
transliteration: Oṃ śrīṃ Mahālakṣmyai namaḥ
meaning: Salutations to Mahalakshmi, associated traditionally with auspiciousness, abundance and well-being.

title: Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya
purpose: Beginnings, removal of obstacles, focus, auspicious action
source: Śrīmad Bhāgavata tradition; appears at Bhāgavata 2.1 invocation and 4.8.54.
category: Work / Success / New Beginnings, Vishnu / Krishna / Rama
sanskrit: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय ॥
transliteration: Oṃ namo bhagavate Vāsudevāya
meaning: Salutations to Bhagavan Vasudeva/Krishna.

title: Mahamrityunjaya

meaning: I bow to Hanuman, swift as the mind and wind, master of the senses, foremost among the wise, son of Vayu and messenger of Rama.
